title: I am so disgusted in Kitchen Aid
text: I am so disgusted in Kitchen Aid. I bought this coffee maker less than 6 months ago and it is broken already. I use it for one travel mug a day and I don't think that is abusing it. It turns on and off but that is all is does. I am so disgusted in Kitchen Aid. I was going to make my new kitchen all Kitchen Aid but this makes me stand back and rethink all of that. This is the biggest piece of crap I've ever purchased from Kitchen Aid. I have at least four other small appliances from Kitchen Aid. Glad I didn't buy the large appliances yet. I'd hate to open my refridgerator and see it doesn't work after opening it just a few times or turn my stove on and realize dinner will be cold because it is a piece of junk like all of their other appliances. This might be the end for me with Kitchen Aid.
